p1_findings.finding: row_lane_enable_w and psum_lane_enable_w are kept vector aliases of the same issue_accept_w. The accumulator updates remain inside an outer if(issue_accept_w), making each nested lane condition semantically redundant. A keep attribute preserves a net identity but does not by itself instantiate a characterized buffer tree or guarantee that the source fanout is <=32.
p1_findings.risk: DC may collapse the redundant conditions, preserve 192 alias loads on the source, or repair them with buffers whose transition/capacitance/area cost remains high. M477's anonymous violating nets cannot be mapped to this RTL transform by source inspection alone.
p1_findings.required_action: Use same-constraint DC as the decision experiment. Require zero max-transition, max-capacitance and max-fanout violations and inspect the mapped enable fanout tree; otherwise immediate NO-GO.

p1_findings.finding: The backpressure-safe wrapper is functionally unchanged from M476r2, so prefetch_valid, issue_valid/last, row IDs and psum_write_ready still feed prefetch_ready combinationally. Static review finds no internal ready cycle, but a full-controller source must keep valid/payload independent of ready.
p1_findings.required_action: Measure the path in DC and retain the ready/valid integration rule. M479 does not close or worsen this prior P1 by RTL semantics.

static_rtl_and_handshake_review.m479_core_diff_scope: module rename plus lane-local enable aliases and nested enable tests only

dc_gate.required_same_inputs: M477 3.000 ns SDC, TSMC28 HPC+ slow/fast libraries, ideal clock, ZeroWireload and hold-fix flow
pass_conditions: Setup and hold timing paths nonnegative.
All five constraint groups clean, including max-capacitance, max-transition and max-fanout.
Mapped report shows the intended lane-local fanout structure rather than optimized-away aliases.
No area/PPA claim is made until the final clean result and an independent DC hammer.
dc_gate.failure_rule: Any remaining design-rule violation is immediate NO-GO for M479; do not tune constraints or relax max_fanout.
